newsitem.title: GERMANY: Munich Re ups Vereinsbank stake to 5.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Munich Re ups Vereinsbank stake to 5.4 pct.

text.p: Bayerische Vereinsbank AG said on Wednesday that reinsurer Muenchner Rueckversicherungs-Gesellschaft, or Munich Re, had increased its stake in the bank to 5.4 percent from 4.4 percent.
In July, Deutsche Bank AG said it had amassed a stake of 5.21 percent stake in the Munich bank, triggering a wave of takeover speculation.
Munich Re ups Vereinsbank stake to 5.4 pct
Vereinsbank said in a statement that Munich Re had informed the bank on Tuesday that it owned 5.4 percent of the voting rights in Vereinsbank.
Munich Re had announced a 4.4 percent holding on October 16 this year.
The increase resulted from Munich Re's takeover of health insurer Deutsche Krankenversicherungs AG which holds shares in Vereinsbank, the statement said.
The takeover has since been completed and DKV's stake in Vereinsbank has therefore been added to Munich Re's original Vereinsbank stake, the statement said.
